spec.title: About this view

options.content:
Is client experience failing at RF, the AP uplink, DHCP/DNS, or site 2's Wi-Fi path?

Missing or partial evidence is Unknown. [Runbook](https://github.com/iT3E/tnwks-ops/blob/main/docs/network/architecture.md)

spec.description: Purpose, scope and the interpretation of missing evidence.

spec.title: AP uptime
spec.description:
AP inventory/uptime. Device-only identifiers; household client names/MACs are excluded.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: AP uplink
spec.description:
Negotiated uplink speed. A slow or errored uplink can masquerade as an RF problem.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Wi-Fi collector failures
spec.description:
Collector-specific failure evidence; HTTP scrape success does not prove the UniFi API refresh succeeded. Counted over the selected range, per site; anything but zero is red.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Clients with weak signal
spec.description:
Wireless devices below -70 dBm at their access point, the whole house. Which ones, and their retries and satisfaction, are on Wi-Fi clients.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Peer path success
spec.description:
Correlate site 2 connectivity loss with AP/uplink and WireGuard/BGP observations. This does not identify individual household clients.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Peer path duration
spec.description:
Bounded transport probe duration; one sample does not measure line-rate Wi-Fi performance.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Site host uplinks
spec.description:
Each site's Windows host NICs with a link, at their negotiated rate (windows_exporter). Site 2's host reaches the router over Wi-Fi only, so its link rate changes with the radio.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Site host uplink traffic
spec.description:
Traffic through each host NIC in use: everything the site sends or receives, the site tunnel included.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Site 2 Wi-Fi signal
spec.description:
The site 2 host's signal at its access point, as UniFi reports it (either site's poller). A change of AP or channel starts a new line.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Site 2 Wi-Fi association
spec.description:
How long the site 2 host has been associated. A drop to zero is a reconnect or roam, which interrupts the site's tunnel and BGP sessions.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.
